verdict.rationale: The UK IPO collects user data through online filings and One Login accounts, so a data-use and AI-training privacy posture is a fair question for this service. Nothing in the evidence pack describes any opt-out or policy preventing submitted data from being used to train AI models. The trade mark rights to take legal action against unauthorised brand use are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
